references.text: The Lord speaks to Moses with instructions about the tabernacle and its equipment, in the same way he gives instructions about the wagons and oxen in Numbers 7.
Another introduction where the Lord speaks to Moses from the tent of meeting with specific instructions.
The Lord's speech to Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, showing the repeated pattern where God gives instructions through Moses.
The Lord speaks to Moses in the wilderness of Sinai with instructions about the Levites, in the same context as the service in the sanctuary.
The same formula 'the Lord spoke to Moses and said' is used repeatedly throughout the books of Moses as an introduction to divine instructions.
